scopeAssessment.newDiscoveriesPolicy: Additional original-scope necessities remain executable; unrelated optional coverage is not automatically required.
scopeAssessment.finding: Within the full preserved original inventory and its necessary admitted dependencies, no concrete unfulfilled ropeway/cable/funicular service or access obligation is enumerated. This is bounded applicability evidence, not a national assertion that no such transport exists or matters.
scopeAssessment.discoveryLimit: The entire allowed v2 rail inventory is 2271 reviewed/candidate components, not all Japanese stations or a complete ropeway census. Its 97 special-kind candidates are 78 fixed guideway plus 19 tram. Absence alone cannot establish universal non-applicability; frozen authorization and actual required topology provide the boundary.
scopeAssessment.oldV1: A historical tourism-cable tool names Takao/Tsukuba/Hiei stations. These are not accepted current v2 identities or frozen 086 requirements; do not revive rejected v1 nodes or turn old script names into mandatory new scope.

currentGate.currentReason: The inherited special-tourism obligation lacks an enumerated ropeway/funicular target inventory. Existing monorail/tram coverage alone does not prove it fulfilled; scope and primary service evidence remain to be reviewed.
currentGate.notClaimed: All Japanese operators/services or unrestricted raw timetable reuse
